WITH 
-- Get all sessions for visitors who had at least one transaction in Feb 2017
transactions AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date,
    visitId,
    visitStartTime,
    device.deviceCategory
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) as h
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170201' AND '20170228'
    AND h.transaction.transactionId IS NOT NULL
),
-- Get distinct visitors with transactions
visitors_with_transactions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM transactions
),
-- Find first visit date in Feb 2017 for each visitor
first_visit AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    MIN(date) as first_visit_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170201' AND '20170228'
    AND fullVisitorId IN (SELECT fullVisitorId FROM visitors_with_transactions)
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
),
-- Find first transaction date and device category for each visitor in Feb 2017
first_transaction AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date as first_transaction_date,
    deviceCategory as transaction_device
  FROM transactions
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId ORDER BY date, visitStartTime) = 1
)
SELECT 
  fv.fullVisitorId,
  fv.first_visit_date,
  ft.first_transaction_date,
  DATE_DIFF(
    PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', ft.first_transaction_date),
    PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', fv.first_visit_date),
    DAY
  ) as days_elapsed,
  ft.transaction_device
FROM first_visit fv
JOIN first_transaction ft ON fv.fullVisitorId = ft.fullVisitorId
ORDER BY days_elapsed DESC
